content: - This is the strictest evaluation, as it takes into account both the BIO label and the category assigned to each individual token. Being able to discern between two contiguous sensitive entities of the same type is relevant not only because it is helpful when producing fake replacements, but because it also yields more accurate statistics of the sensitive information present in a given document collection.
